# The Necronomicon
[color=#999999][italic]"Join us..."[/italic][/color]
As the shift starts, an old tape recorder somewhere aboard finishes reading from the Book of the Dead. Something answers: a [color=#a01818]Kandarian Demon[/color], bound to the [color=#a01818]Necronomicon[/color].
## For the crew - [bold]The book is the demon's anchor.[/bold] It can only be destroyed by [color=orange]fire[/color]. Light it with a lighter, welder or anything hot, and keep it burning for about twenty seconds. - [bold]Hold onto it.[/bold] While a living, unpossessed person carries the book (in hand, a pocket or a bag), it [italic]cannot[/italic] vanish back into the ether. - [bold]Anyone could be a Deadite.[/bold] They look completely normal until they reveal themselves. Then their skin goes corpse-pale, their eyes turn milky white and they start screaming. - Deadites don't stay down. Beat one into critical and it gets back up shortly after. A heavy slash while it's down severs its head, which stops it for good. Burning the book ends them all. - [bold]Mindshields[/bold] protect against possession, until a revealed Deadite reads the passage that melts them away. - [bold]Chaplains can exorcise Deadites.[/bold] Cuff, buckle or down the suspect, then use the [bold]Exorcise[/bold] verb with a Bible in hand and stand still for about twenty seconds. A Deadite comes back as themselves, healed, and the book can't claim them again for ten minutes. A mindshield implanted in the Deadite first halves the time. Anyone else is unharmed: the rite simply finds nothing. The chaplain needs a short rest between rites. - [bold]Demonspawn[/bold] grow into tall, grey, black-eyed adults after ten minutes. Both forms are [color=#88bbff]melted to dust[/color] by holy water (splash or spray it) or a Bible (hit them with it, use it on them or throw it).
## For the demon - You start [bold]incorporeal[/bold]: invisible to the living, untouchable and unable to touch anything. - [bold]Soul Power[/bold] comes from fear: monsters near the crew, monsters speaking, attacks, witnesses and supernatural events. Spend it in the [bold]Skill Store[/bold]. - [bold]Manifest Necronomicon[/bold] puts the book in the world where you stand. JOIN US reaches 12 tiles from you while the book is in the world, and possession needs the victim within 20 tiles of the book (they can run while it happens). - [bold]JOIN US[/bold] prepares a victim (a Deadite bite does too). [bold]Possess[/bold] then turns them into a disguised Deadite and uses a charge. You start with two. - [bold]Demonic Possession[/bold] is harmless: the victim collapses and your words come out of their mouth. With [bold]Speak to the Station[/bold], your next sentence becomes an announcement in their name. - [bold]Physical Form[/bold] lets you fight in a body of your chosen shape. If it dies, you return to the ether. - [bold]Deadite Evolution[/bold] in the store improves all your Deadites, present and future. Pick two of four paths, each with two tiers: [bold]Infiltrator[/bold] (silent bites, slower exorcisms, hiding again after revealing), [bold]Brute[/bold] (harder hits, faster recovery, damage resistance), [bold]Stalker[/bold] (speed, longer bites, crippling bites) or [bold]Screamer[/bold] (a terrifying shriek that can knock people down). - Your HUD shows your Soul Power, your charges and where your book is. Talk privately with other Kandarian entities using [bold]:k[/bold] (Ancient Sumerian).
## Victory The Necronomicon wins when no living soul remains aboard. The crew wins by burning the book. The round-end summary lists souls consumed, possessions, Deadites, Demonspawn, fear harvested, rituals, exorcisms and how long the demon lasted.
